verdict.rationale: Lambda explicitly advertises a path to reserved/committed capacity pricing ('Contact us for reserved capacity at our lowest prices') and also offers Private Cloud for large single-tenant multi-year deployments, confirming the capability exists. However, this is sales-assisted only — there's no self-service reservation mechanism, no published discount tiers/terms, and on-demand pages emphasize 'No long-term commitments,' contrasting with the reserved offering. Missing for 10: self-service reservation/commitment workflow, published discount rates or contract terms, and independent evidence of actual reserved pricing outcomes.
